captions.detailed: A service-station style manual pump featuring a main red cylindrical barrel, a black rectangular base with foot pads, and a side-mounted circular pressure gauge housing. A silver-colored piston rod extends vertically from the top of the barrel, capped with a black T-handle crossbar that has dual handle grips. A black folding handle grip/sleeve is mounted asymmetrically around the top bar, and a simulated hose clip is positioned near the bottom of the body.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a service-station floor pump with a red cylindrical body, black foot-pad base, a side-mounted circular gauge, and a silver piston rod. The handle assembly should translate vertically as a prismatic joint, and include a rotatable folding grip around the crossbar and a rotating gauge needle.
captions.factory: The object is constructed using an ArticulatedObject framework. The main body is built from a red cylinder for the barrel, combined with a black rectangular base, foot pads, and a side-mounted gauge bracket. The gauge needle is modeled as a separate rotatable visual. The moving piston assembly uses a silver cylinder for the rod and a crosswise black cylinder for the handle bar. A continuous rotational joint is defined for the folding handle grip around the crossbar, and a prismatic joint is established for the vertical movement of the piston rod relative to the pump body.
